title: Claude Code Version 2.1.69-2.1.101 Release Wave
description: Claude Code underwent intensive iteration from v2.1.69 to v2.1.101 between March and April 2026. Key updates include Remote Control for browser/mobile access, Multi-Repository Context Window for working across multiple repos, Enhanced Collaborative Tools (announced April 11), MCP (Model Context Protocol) enhancements, improved VS Code integration, and enhanced autonomous coding features achieving 80.8% on SWE-bench and 72.5% on OSWorld.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Generally Available
description: Anthropic's latest Opus model, Claude Opus 4.7, is now rolling out on GitHub Copilot. The model delivers stronger multi-step task performance and more reliable agentic execution based on early testing.

title: Fix Merge Conflicts with Copilot Cloud Agent
description: New 'Fix with Copilot' button on github.com allows fixing merge conflicts in three clicks powered by Copilot cloud agent. Clicking the button triggers a comment from the agent to resolve conflicts automatically.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Policy via Custom Properties
description: Organizations can now selectively enable GitHub Copilot cloud agent (CCA) access on a per-organization basis using custom properties, replacing the previous all-or-nothing approach for enterprise admins and AI managers.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents on GitHub.com
description: Model selection is now available for Claude and Codex third-party coding agents on github.com. Users can select a model when initiating agent work, similar to Copilot cloud agent functionality.

title: Copilot Data Residency in US + EU and FedRAMP Compliance
description: GitHub Copilot now supports data residency for US and EU regions, ensuring all inference processing and associated data stay within designated geography. For US government customers, all model hosts achieved FedRAMP compliance.

title: Manage Agent Skills with GitHub CLI
description: New 'gh skill' command in GitHub CLI makes it easy to discover, install, and manage agent skills, which are reshaping how developers work with AI coding agents.
